space-shooter.name: Neon Swarm
space-shooter.gameLoop: Pilot the last starfighter above Vega Prime: weave through glowing bug-ship swarms, chain kills for combo power, grab shield cells, and survive all 5 waves to clear the sector.

enemies.role: basic drifter that flies straight at the player
sine-wave mover that is hard to lead with shots
fast diver that breaks formation and lunges

space-shooter.progression: Five waves with growing counts and speed; a shield cell drops before each wave.
space-shooter.scoring: 100 per kill, combo multiplier up to x5 for chained kills, 250 bonus per cleared wave.

space-shooter.name: Rust Convoy
space-shooter.gameLoop: Ride shotgun on a rust-bucket freighter convoy: intercept raiders before they reach the freighters, magnetize scrap for repairs, and keep at least one freighter alive through the belt.

enemies.role: nimble raider that strafes the convoy line
drifting mine that pulls the player in close
slow pod that latches onto a freighter and drains hull

space-shooter.progression: Three belt sectors; raider count and mine density rise per sector.
space-shooter.scoring: 150 per raider destroyed, 300 per freighter kept at full hull, scrap restores 1 health per 5 pickups.
space-shooter.winCondition: Escort at least one freighter through all 3 sectors.
space-shooter.loseCondition: All freighters destroyed, or the escort ship falls.

space-shooter.name: Void Choir
space-shooter.gameLoop: Face the singing void: silence choir-wisps before their hymn completes, dodge tightening rings of bellfire, and shatter the Silence Ark in a final duel.

enemies.role: chanter that buffs nearby foes until silenced
ring-shaped gunner firing slow bellfire spirals
final ark that alternates spiral barrages and lunges

space-shooter.progression: Four hymn movements of rising density, then the Silence Ark duel.
space-shooter.scoring: 120 per wisp, 200 per herald, 1000 for the ark; no-hit movement bonus of 500.

endless-runner.name: Neon Rooftops
endless-runner.gameLoop: Sprint across neon rooftops: jump vent spikes and billboard crates, slide under patrol drones, chain coin arcs, and outrun the ever-faster city scroll.

obstacles.role: low rooftop spikes; jump over them
tall ad crate; needs a full jump
hovering drone; slide under it

endless-runner.collectibles: Coin lines and coin arcs over obstacles, 10 points each.
endless-runner.progression: Endless: scroll speed ramps from 280 to 560 px/s while spawn gaps tighten from 600 to 480 px.
endless-runner.scoring: 1 point per meter travelled plus 10 per coin; best run persists locally.

endless-runner.name: Tide Caves
endless-runner.gameLoop: Flee the flooding tide caves: leap urchin beds, duck falling stalactites, time surge gates between waves, and ride the current as far as it takes you.

obstacles.role: spiky seabed patch; jump clean over it
falling ceiling spike telegraphed by drips
tide gate that slams shut on a rhythm; pass on the lull

endless-runner.collectibles: Pearls tucked behind risky jumps, 25 points each.
endless-runner.progression: Endless: current speed and gate tempo rise the deeper you dive.
endless-runner.scoring: 2 points per meter plus 25 per pearl; depth markers every 500 m.
endless-runner.winCondition: Endless: set a new depth record.
endless-runner.loseCondition: Touch an urchin, stalactite, or closed surge gate.

endless-runner.name: Sand Express
endless-runner.gameLoop: Ride the roof of the Sand Express: hop cactus crates, leap dune gaps between cars, dodge swooping vultures, and hang on as the train keeps accelerating.

obstacles.role: prickly cargo stack; jump it or slide gaps beneath
gap between cars; only a full jump clears it
swooping bird; duck under its dive line

endless-runner.collectibles: Passenger tickets fluttering above gaps, 15 points each.
endless-runner.progression: Endless: train speed climbs per car passed; sandstorm gusts narrow jump windows.
endless-runner.scoring: 1 point per meter plus 15 per ticket; car milestones grant 100.
endless-runner.winCondition: Endless: ride further than your best run.
endless-runner.loseCondition: Fall in a dune gap or take 2 hits.

side-scroller.name: Mosslight Hollow
side-scroller.gameLoop: Carry a fading lantern through Mosslight Hollow: platform across glowing grottos, dodge thorn pits and spore clouds, relight beacon braziers, and reach the Heartcap gate.

obstacles.role: spiked hollow floor; jump or double-jump across
drifting toxic puff; time your pass between pulses
moss ledge that falls away after one landing

side-scroller.collectibles: Fireflies that extend lantern light, plus beacon braziers as checkpoints.
side-scroller.progression: Six grotto stages ending at the Heartcap gate; lantern dims faster in later stages.
side-scroller.scoring: 50 per firefly, 200 per lit brazier, time bonus per stage.
side-scroller.winCondition: Reach the Heartcap gate with the lantern lit.
side-scroller.loseCondition: Lose all 3 lives, or the lantern dies in darkness.

side-scroller.name: Clockwork Foundry
side-scroller.gameLoop: Escape the foundry floor: ride piston platforms, dodge steam vents and gear crushers, short the spark conduits, and climb from the furnace to the skylight.

obstacles.role: timed floor vent; cross between blasts
syncopated press; slip through on the open beat
live wire bridge; cross only while it flickers off

side-scroller.collectibles: Brass cogs hidden on risky routes, 25 points each.
side-scroller.progression: Four foundry floors of rising machine tempo, then the skylight climb.
side-scroller.scoring: 25 per cog, 150 per floor cleared, 500 no-damage floor bonus.
side-scroller.winCondition: Reach the skylight and escape the foundry.

side-scroller.name: Tidebreak Docks
side-scroller.gameLoop: Deliver parcels across the harbor: hop moored boats, squeeze past barrel stacks, dodge swooping gulls, and beat the tide clock to the lighthouse post.

obstacles.role: swaying gap between boats; jump on the swing
toppling cargo; pass before it falls
swooping gulls that dive at parcel carriers

side-scroller.collectibles: Stamps on risky detours, 10 points each; parcels delivered add 100.
side-scroller.progression: Five piers ending at the lighthouse; the tide clock shortens each leg.
side-scroller.scoring: 100 per delivered parcel plus 10 per stamp, minus 5 per second over par.
side-scroller.winCondition: Deliver 6 parcels to the lighthouse post.
side-scroller.loseCondition: Lose all 3 lives, or the tide clock floods the route.

battle-2d.name: Ember Arena
battle-2d.theme: Trial by fire in the Ember Arena
battle-2d.gameLoop: Enter the Ember Arena: duel waves of cinder foes, dash through flame volleys, slam brutes into braziers, and stand as the last fighter across 5 rounds.

enemies.role: quick skirmisher that nips in packs
slow heavy with a sweeping slam
ranged foe firing arcing fire bolts

battle-2d.progression: Five elimination rounds; round 5 fields a brute pair with archer cover.
battle-2d.scoring: 100 per imp, 250 per archer, 400 per brute; round-clear heal of 1.

battle-2d.name: Frostmoot Ring
battle-2d.theme: Honor duel at the Frostmoot Ring
battle-2d.gameLoop: Fight for the Frostmoot crown: circle duellists on cracking ice, bait charges into snowdrifts, shatter the glacier troll's armor plates, and claim three banners.

enemies.role: fast yipper that circles and nips
armored mini-boss; crack plates then strike flesh

battle-2d.progression: Three banners: pups, then shard-throwers, then the glacier troll bout.
battle-2d.scoring: 120 per pup, 220 per thrower, 800 for the troll; style bonus for untouched rounds.

battle-2d.name: Junkyard Rumble
battle-2d.theme: Scrap brawl in the Junkyard Rumble
battle-2d.gameLoop: Brawl through the junkyard: bonk can-chuckers with their own cans, outrun the magnet hound's pull, topple the compactor boss's stacks onto it, and rule the scrap heap.

enemies.role: lobber whose cans can be batted back
charger that drags metal and fighters alike
boss that drops crush stacks; bait it under them

battle-2d.progression: Two warm-up brawls then the compactor boss bout.
battle-2d.scoring: 100 per chucker, 200 per hound, 1000 for the boss; batted-can KOs pay double.

farming.name: Sunny Acres
farming.gameLoop: Work a 6x4 field: plant turnip or pumpkin seeds, water every growth stage, harvest ripe crops for coins, and bank 500 coins to win.

obstacles.role: each growth stage needs watering before it grows
seeds cost coins; pumpkins pay best but tie up plots longest

farming.collectibles: Harvest payouts: 12 coins per turnip, 55 per pumpkin.
farming.progression: Day cycle: 60-second days; morning rain may water thirsty plots.
farming.scoring: Coins from harvests; banked total persists as the local best.
farming.loseCondition: None: endless cozy farming until the goal is banked.

farming.name: Moonpetal Greenhouse
farming.theme: Night shift at the Moonpetal Greenhouse
farming.gameLoop: Tend a moonlit greenhouse: plant glowpetals and starbeans, shield beds from frost drafts, prune spore blight before it spreads, and fill the 300-bloom order book.

obstacles.role: night chill that stalls unshielded beds
spreading blight; prune fast or lose the row
grow-lights drain the cell; harvests recharge it

farming.collectibles: Bloom orders: glowpetals fill 1 slot, starbeans fill 3.
farming.progression: Night shifts of 90 seconds; drafts and blight intensify per shift.
farming.scoring: Blooms banked toward the 300 order; wilted rows subtract 10.
farming.loseCondition: None: endless shifts until the order book is full.

farming.name: Ember Terraces
farming.theme: Dry season on the Ember Terraces
farming.gameLoop: Farm volcanic terraces: plant ember peppers and ash melons, ration well water across tiers, clear ash-fall before it smothers sprouts, and ship 400 crates before the season ends.

obstacles.role: falling ash that smothers unwatched sprouts
limited well water shared across all tiers
hot cracks that retire plots until cooled

farming.collectibles: Crate shipments: peppers ship 1 crate, melons ship 3.
farming.progression: Ten 60-second days; ash-fall thickens and rations tighten each day.
farming.scoring: Crates shipped toward the 400 goal; retired plots slow the pace.
farming.loseCondition: Season ends with fewer than 400 crates shipped.
